title: Moving from Playing with AI to Implementing AI - Lee Stott

developers. We're here live at the Agent
Conf in Berlin in the sun and you gave
the keynote this morning. So, what did
you cover?
>> Yeah, thanks Chris. So, yeah, so I gave
the keynote around the the generation of
AI and Agentic AI. So, really looking at
how developers are using software
engineering principles across their
implementations using things like GitHub
Copilot and using Microsoft Foundry to
host and build your solutions.
>> And you showed us more of more of things
like there were lots of options in
